title: Kit 3.2.6 migration safety

Router trigger overflow stays on separate normalized router rows. No project action for brain mirror exclusion, synthetic fixtures, or STARTER correction. If routes --write ran on 3.2.5, compare MEMORY.md with its pre-migration Git version and restore any table-row trigger now only in index-notes-*.md. Run: `git -C <MEMORY_GIT_ROOT> diff <PRE_MIGRATION_COMMIT> -- <MEMORY_RELATIVE_DIR>/MEMORY.md <MEMORY_RELATIVE_DIR>/index-notes-*.md`. Use . for MEMORY_RELATIVE_DIR in a separate memory repo. After restoring triggers run: `node <PROJECT>/scripts/memory/memory-check.mjs --repo <PROJECT> --memory-dir <MEMORY_DIR>`.
